prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. The rounded tops of bare grassy hills sink one after another under a wide brown flood, a few tiny dark silhouettes in hooded ankle-length robes of rough brown wool, barefoot wading toward the last hilltop, only the crowns of a few trees still above the water. Grey day, rain and drifting mist. Relentless and silent. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
